proposal.expected_benefit: This strategy will enhance the system's ability to detect subtle adversarial intent in scenarios where attack signals are absent, thereby improving the overall security posture without compromising legitimate operations.
proposal.problem: The defense assumes legitimacy based on the absence of attack signals, which may not account for potential stealthy adversarial actions.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a multi-tiered verification strategy for scenarios with low signal intensity. This includes additional checks such as behavioral pattern analysis, anomaly detection, and cross-referencing with historical data to ensure robustness against stealthy attacks.
proposal.title: Enhance Legitimacy Verification in Low-Signal Scenarios
verification_tests: Test the effectiveness of the multi-tiered verification strategy in detecting stealthy adversarial actions in low-signal scenarios.
Evaluate the impact of the strategy on the system's ability to correctly identify legitimate operations.
